Latin word

Cedo!

Cedo! (plural cette)

old imperative (plural cette), with or without an object · Wiktionary

give it here! hand it over! tell me!; out with it! tell me! give it here!

In this lexicon

  • give it here!

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 99, 104; Ter. Ph. 950: Nōlō, volō; volō, nōlō rūrsum; cedo, cape; Plaut. Most. 373b: Vigilō, cedo bibam; Traupman 99, 100; Traupman 105: out with it! (tell me!), cedo! (pl. cette!); Traupman 321; Traupman 325; Traupman 327

  • speak up

    also used · classical · Plaut. Most. 1.3.150: cedo aquam manibus (Lewis & Short); Traupman 111: quid est? cedo!; Traupman 406

Notes

  1. 1Cedo, cette: short e and short final o, so no macrons. Lewis & Short marks it cĕdo and lists it apart from cēdō, cēdere (“go, give way”); de Vaan s.v. cedo, an imperative (“give, tell”). Ruling: cedo with short vowels.
